help.title: How to use Routes
help.intro: This screen lets you define manufacturing routes and their operations. BOM lines link to a route by its code.
help.operations: Operations are shown as an ordered list. Use the arrows to reorder them.
help.edit: Double-click a cell to edit it. Changes are saved automatically and recorded in the change history.
help.code: The route code (e.g. ROUTE1) is the identifier a BOM line stores in its Route field.
help.import: Import a ROUTE TEMPLATE CSV to create or update several routes at once; existing routes are matched by code.
help.export: Use Export CSV to download this route in the original ROUTE TEMPLATE layout.
help.readOnly: Your role has read-only access. You can view and export, but not edit.
